### 2026-10-11 – FInal ENTRY for Week 1!

**2.52h**

FInal ENTRY for Week 1!

WHAT I DID:
I made some changes to the firmware provided in the guide and changed the name of some of the menu options.
Then I changed the default sprite to  a cat which I searched up from google.

![cat](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/amKXWkggCyjJw2xKYyfRbZCiJrdn6xQT/32651541b44a6dcad5345f7ac4ec11ad3adbabe8a67fe4c9e0e6bfcbe686d115.png)

After making changes to the code, I wrote A README.md file and then realized that I had to set up my repo.

After setting up my repo which took some time, I finally ended by adding the parts to buy from amazon and JLCPCB

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/amKXWkggCyjJw2xKYyfRbZCiJrdn6xQT/497ff352b0e6575231ca628f8be87cff6b82bd21c75c37f3f2c3d11efe4a2876.png)

Then I thought I'll just slightly desgin my pcb and added the relieved face emoji and also m sprite and played around with the tools

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/amKXWkggCyjJw2xKYyfRbZCiJrdn6xQT/2b563ba9293fa02040ec9fe401aed3be8c2304a8c95a049cc68ffbf781f0b925.png)

I am so excited!!!!
